model_claims.text: Calling ceil with a NaN value and options parameter previously returned 1; after the change it no longer returns 1 (it raises an exception).
Calling floor with a NaN value and options parameter previously returned 4; after the change it no longer returns 4 (it raises an exception).
After the change, ceil/floor with NaN and options behaves the same as ceil/floor without options (i.e., both reject NaN).
model_claims.source_quote: Reject a floating-point NaN before binary search, matching both functions' existing behavior without options.

model_claims.text: The change fixes two regressions that were failing on the master branch and now pass.
model_claims.source_quote: Two regressions fail on master and pass with this change.
